title: Farm Scene 9 — Looking After the Animals
purpose: Support inference, needs-based language and purposeful action verbs using a farm care scene.

sentenceModels: The child is carrying water to the cow.
The child is feeding the chickens.
The pig is inside the gate.

adultSupport.focus: Ask what each animal needs and which child is helping with that need.
starterPrompts: Which child is helping the cow?
expansionPrompts: What should happen next after the water arrives?
Tell me how the children are looking after the farm animals.

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 3 automatic pass against the main teaching targets.
